articles.title: 韬定律有多牛！Mate 90 Pro Max下麒麟9050 Pro性能完全展示 部分场景完胜第五代骁龙8至尊版
articles.text:
快科技10月5日消息，此前数码测评团队极客湾已经完成了对华为Mate XT2搭载的标准版麒麟9050芯片的全性能拆解探究，最近他们又放出了华为Mate90 Pro Max专属搭载的麒麟9050 Pro的完整性能体验报告，实测表现继续给所有人带来惊喜。
从极客湾放出的多轮实测数据可以看到，满负载游戏测试环节里，搭载麒麟9050 Pro处理器的华为Mate90 Pro Max，相比前代旗舰芯片的提升幅度非常亮眼。
热门开放世界游戏《原神》在890P分辨率设置下运行的时候，Mate90 Pro Max整机功耗仅为4.2W就能全程跑满60帧满帧体验，这个表现甚至比前代同系列Pro Max机型在更低分辨率下的跑分成绩还要好，整体能效表现优于部分搭载骁龙8 Elite Gen5的旗舰机型，表现已经接近iPhone 17 Pro Max（A19 Pro）和部分搭载骁龙8 Elite Extreme Gen6的顶级旗舰机型。
在另一款高画质开放世界游戏《鸣潮》的测试中，目前Mate90 Pro Max仅适配支持648P分辨率，对比前代Mate80 Pro Max的表现已经有了跨越式进步，帧率大幅抬升的同时整机功耗不升反降，综合表现优于部分搭载天玑9500的旗舰机型，性能能效表现同样接近iPhone 17 Pro Max（A19 Pro）和部分骁龙8 Elite机型。
在新上线的高画质游戏《异环》的实测环节里，Mate90 Pro Max对比前代旗舰同样进步明显，虽然整机功耗相比前代小幅提升了约0.4W，但平均帧率直接拉高了10帧以上，最终的实际表现几乎和天玑9500、骁龙8 Elite机型的表现持平，完全达到当前安卓旗舰第一梯队水准。
这次麒麟9050 Pro采用了双层逻辑电路的特殊处理方案，在相同的平面硅片占地面积里容纳了更多晶体管，同时芯片的运行频率也得到了进一步拉高，整体硬件基础大幅升级。
相比前代芯片的三丛集CPU架构，麒麟9050 Pro直接扩充到了四丛集的全新设计，超大核依然保留1颗，原本的4颗大核被进一步细分成2颗性能大核和4颗能效大核，负责极低负载场景的超低功耗小核缩减到2颗，架构调度的灵活性大幅提升。
特别的是麒麟9050 Pro所有性能大核都支持超线程技术，这颗处理器本质上可以看作是9核心16线程的特殊架构设计，在CPU多核性能、GPU能效表现等多个维度，实测成绩都胜过了谷歌今年基于台积电N3P工艺打造的新旗舰处理器Tensor G6，也就是谷歌Pixel 11 Pro XL搭载的那颗自研芯片。
整个系列测试完成之后，极客湾给出的综合评价是这款芯片进步幅度巨大，麒麟9050 Pro从日常负载能效、跑分成绩到三款主流高画质游戏的实测表现，整体素质已经对标友商基于N3P先进工艺打造的旗舰处理器，加上目前部分高负载游戏的超分、光追、HDR特性还没有完全针对这款芯片做专属适配，后续华为和游戏厂商完成针对性优化之后，这款旗舰机的游戏表现还有非常大的提升空间。
不少数码爱好者看完这份完整测试都感叹，现在韬定律下的逻辑折叠技术还远没有挖到上限，只是当前比较保守的落地版本就能拿出这种接近全球第一梯队旗舰芯片的表现，等后续华为在芯片制造工艺上再进一步突破之后，未来新一代麒麟处理器的实际表现完全不敢想象，这种完全跳出传统摩尔定律路径的自研技术路线，实打实走出了属于中国芯片的全新升级路径。

根据上汽集团销量数据显示，智己汽车1-9月累计销售6万辆，同比增长40.1%，其中全新一代智己LS6上市57分钟，新增订单突破1.1万台。
据悉，全新一代智己LS6于9月23日正式上市，定位“全线控大五座家庭SUV”，官方指导价20.29万元起，叠加上市权益后19.79万元起。
全新一代智己LS6的车身尺寸为4937mm×1988mm×1671mm，轴距2960mm，提供拉斐尔紫、尊贵黑、迪斯科灰、璀璨白、宇拓绿等车色，内饰有深邃晴十黑和温柔象牙米两种主题，搭配21英寸群星钻行闪银轮毂等多款轮辋选择。
其中底盘是全新一代LS6的最大亮点，全系标配全线控灵蜥数字底盘，采用三重安全冗余设计，配备SynVector全域线控矢量扭矩协同控制，响应时间仅20毫秒。

智能配置上，全新一代LS6搭载IM AD Zero智驾系统，配备微觉域综合场景AEB、听觉域2.0和驾驶式关怀辅助驾驶交互系统。
IM Clavy龙虾智能体整合强眼龙鹰屏、灵犀仿生扬声器和智域树AI生态，主打“越开越聪明”的AI学习能力。
三电方面，新车搭载NEO三电架构，配备全新NEO强驱电机和全球800V宽电压平台，搭配IM ECU Master全新版大功率管理系统3.0。全系标配800V超快充平台和宁德时代高能量密度电池。

articles.title: 四代麒麟芯片齐亮相！余承东硬核解读：何为韬定律、麒麟9050系列到底有多强
articles.text:
快科技10月4日消息，今天余承东本人公开发布视频，面向大众硬核解读了基于韬定律打造的麒麟9050自研芯片。
视频现场Mate60、Mate70、Mate80、Mate90四代搭载麒麟芯片的机型同台亮相，余承东也直言，正是此前迭代打磨的381款各类芯片产品做铺垫，才有了如今这套基于韬定律落地的麒麟9050。
按照余承东的分享，过去几十年全球整个芯片行业都在死磕摩尔定律，思路非常直白，就是拼命把芯片内部的晶体管做的更小、排布得更密集，靠堆晶体管总数量来拉升芯片整体性能。
但这条路现在已经实实在在走到了尽头，物理尺寸的缩小已经摸到了原子级的物理极限，再往下推进研发难度指数级暴涨，制造成本也会疯狂飙升，哪怕砸下天量投入，也很难再拿到之前那种量级的性能大突破。
所以华为直接跳出了所有人挤破头的传统赛道，换了一套全新的技术思路，不靠缩小零件体积卷性能，转而靠优化传输流程省下数据跑通的时间，这就是韬定律最核心的底层逻辑。
这套思路不需要费劲把芯片内部的基础零件做的更小，反而大刀阔斧优化芯片内部的全部走线布局，让数据信号少绕弯路、少走无用的空路，传输速度更快、延迟压得更低，整机的流畅度自然就有了质的提升。
而落地这套黑科技的核心大招，就是华为自研的逻辑折叠技术。
过往传统芯片的电路布局，就像一层平平无奇的小平房，所有线路都平铺在同一个平面上，信号传输往往要绕很远的路，效率极低还容易产生发热浪费。
华为直接把这套平铺的平房改成了立体高楼，通过逻辑折叠技术把电路分层堆叠，再在层与层之间装上垂直互联的高速电梯。信号不用在平面上长途绕路，上下层之间直接快速传输，总传输距离大幅缩短，运行效率直接翻倍提升。
这套技术带来的实测性能提升全部都是肉眼可见的实实在在的进步：CPU多核性能提升23%，日常打开各类APP、多任务来回切换全程丝滑不卡顿；GPU渲染性能暴涨40%，运行大型手游的时候帧率更稳，画面呈现的画质也更细腻。
NPU人工智能算力更是直接飙升140%，各类端侧AI功能、智能运算的响应速度都有了大幅升级，日常使用的智能交互体验提升非常明显。
说到底二者的核心区别非常清晰，摩尔定律的思路是拼命把零件做的更小，靠堆料挤压性能上限，韬定律的思路则是把芯片内部的数据通路修得更短、让数据跑的更快，靠架构革新直接拉高用户实际使用体验。
不需要去极致追赶最先进的制程工艺，仅凭这套立体堆叠的全新架构，华为就实现了芯片性能的跨越式突破，麒麟9050这颗完全自主研发的芯片，实打实让整个国产半导体行业走出了一条完全属于自己的全新技术路径。

articles.title: 张朝阳被称学历最高大佬 毕业清华物理系赴美留学
articles.text:
近日，张朝阳被称“学历最高大佬”登上热搜，核心在于其西安高考状元、清华物理系、麻省理工博士后的学术履历在互联网大佬圈中形成断层式领先。
1981年，17岁的张朝阳以西安高考理科状元身份考入清华大学物理系，随后考取李政道奖学金赴美留学。在麻省理工学院获得凝聚态物理博士学位并完成博士后研究，这一专业方向以高难度著称。中国初代互联网创业者多为本科学历，张朝阳的MIT博士学历属于独一档存在。
1996年回国创办爱特信公司，1998年推出搜狐网，开创中国门户时代，2000年在纳斯达克上市。相比其他互联网企业盲目扩张，张朝阳坚持不投资地产、不进军游戏（搜狐畅游除外），公司长期无负债，现金流健康。
2021年起开设《张朝阳的物理课》，坚持在黑板上手推复杂公式，讲解量子力学、相对论等硬核内容。他强调即使AI能瞬间给出答案，仍需亲自推导才能掌握原理，反对被动接收信息。

articles.text:
When Anthropic shared financial figures recently with prospective investors in its planned initial public offering, it included a surprising glimpse of the enormous riches about to hit nonprofits and philanthropies—and the cost to shareholders.
The company reported a non-cash expense of more than $660 million for stock used to match employees’ charitable contributions in the six months from October 2025 to March 2026, investors said. articles.title: The Ellisons’ Hollywood Adventure Is About to Scale Up
articles.text:
This is a big week for Larry Ellison. His family’s yearlong pursuit of Warner Bros. Discovery, owner of one of Hollywood’s most iconic film studios, comes to a conclusion on Tuesday when the Ellison-controlled Paramount Skydance is scheduled to complete the $110 billion purchase of WBD. It’s been barely a year since the Ellisons got control of Paramount itself. Once the latest deal is done, Ellison and his son David—who is running the show—will be among the most powerful people in film, television and streaming.
Yes, techies really have taken over entertainment. The question now is whether the Ellisons can make money on this bet. That won’t be easy. The combined company—to be called Skydance, David Ellison announced on Friday—will carry debt amounting to $79 billion. That’s a hefty amount given that the company  starts life with annual earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization of $12 billion. David Ellison’s pitch has been that he’ll find “synergies” (cost cuts in plain English) of $6 billion, bumping up projected Ebitda to $18 billion.

articles.title: 最好的认可 小米18 Pro Max被赞“口袋徕卡” 雷军转发表态
articles.text:
快科技10月4日消息，最近“口袋徕卡”这个说法在数码圈火了，专门用来形容小米18 Pro系列的拍照表现，雷军也转发相关内容做出了回应。
最开始是数码博主晒出小米18 Pro Max实拍的照片，夸赞本代小米旗舰确实在“口袋徕卡”这件事上，做到了新的层次。
这话传开之后，小米集团总裁卢伟冰也出来表态，称口袋徕卡这个评价，是对小米18 Pro系列影像升级最好的认可。
之后雷军直接转发这条微博，用一颗爱心表情完成回复，算是官方接住了这个网友给的外号。
之所以会冒出口袋徕卡这个叫法，和小米18Pro硬件、算法升级分不开。小米18 Pro系列首发徕卡双2亿影像系统，配备2亿像素超大底主摄和2亿像素超大底潜望长焦。
再加上独占的传奇一瞬大模型影像，能够模拟传统相机的虚化、光影质感，不用后期修图，随手拍就能带出徕卡风格的画面效果。
玩摄影的人都清楚，真正的徕卡相机画质很强，但价格贵、体积大，出门还要背着镜头，携带很麻烦，普通人出门旅游很少愿意扛专业相机。
而手机揣兜里就能带出门，按下快门就能出片，所以网友才把成像风格接近相机的小米18 Pro系列叫做口袋徕卡。
这次国庆假期出游，很多人拿小米18 Pro外出拍照，网上到处都是用户实拍样张。口袋徕卡这个称呼，本质就是普通用户对手机影像能力的一种评价。
官方没有刻意炒作这个称号，而是接住网友的民间叫法，也能看出现在手机影像比拼，已经不再只看纸面参数，直出照片的实际观感越来越重要。

articles.title: AI robot company decommissioned its robots ‘Terminator-style’ in a 75-ton vat of molten steel
articles.text:
Figure, a U.S.-based robotics company, decommissioned its old AI robots by making them jump into a 75-ton furnace full of molten steel. According to the company, maintaining its F.02 fleet no longer made sense as its next-generation F.03 is increasing in numbers. However, it said that disassembling its older robots is difficult and time-consuming — they can’t just pass it off to another third party because it contained a lot of proprietary technology, while assigning an internal team to do it would take people off other important projects like the F.04 model that’s in development.
Company CEO Brett Adcock went on to X to help solve this conundrum, asking the social media platform for ideas for “a proper sendoff.” This is where he got an unexpected reply from the Terminator himself, Arnold Schwarzenegger — “You should melt them.” And they did, as you can see in the video below.
You should melt them.August 19, 2026
This started an epic journey, from the Figure team training its robots to jump from the second story of its office building onto an airbag, to finding a foundry willing to accept robots with lithium batteries being dumped into a molten vat of steel. While some may think that jumping off a ledge into a vat of molten steel is an easy thing to do, it actually requires some precision, with the company even referencing stunt artists for the movement.
They eventually found a site in Finland willing to accept the robots, which gave them 24 hours and six melts to complete the process. The decommissioning spectacle turned out to be a complete success, with the F.02 AI robots functioning as intended up to the last moment, despite the extreme heat generated by the molten steel and electromagnetic fields generated by the high-voltage electricity that flowed through the three giant graphite electrodes. The resulting metal bars were eventually taken back to the U.S. and have been machined into limited-edition memorabilia commemorating the F.02.
Most of the F.02 fleet has already been melted down and recycled, with only a few remaining in storage at the company’s headquarters. This should give Figure more space for newer robot models without having to worry about its proprietary technology falling into the hands of the competition. The decommissioning process has also given us a real-life Terminator-style ending, with one F.02 robot even filmed holding a thumbs-up sign as it sinks into molten metal. Let’s just hope that we don’t get a Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines sequel to this wild ending for the F.02.

articles.title: 国产女伴侣机器人能做各种动作！机器人女友或指日可待
articles.text:
现在机器人的动作流畅，皮肤触觉拟真，也有一定智能，这些值得肯定，但我觉得还没到能用“伴侣”这个词的程度。机器人能抬腿、能开合、能感知触碰，和懂你、陪你、关心你，完全是两个维度的东西。我相信未来肯定会出现真假难辨机器人，但从现在来看，还需很长的路要走。
近日，中国机器人品牌维塔智能的一段机器人测试在海外社交平台引发关注。一台仿生人形机器人展现出较为灵活的下肢运动能力，在指令控制下完成抬腿、伸展、双腿开合等一系列动作，整体动作连贯，展现出较高的关节灵活性。
据介绍，维塔智能主要专注于仿生人形机器人研发，其技术方向包括高自由度运动架构以及全身柔性触觉皮肤系统。除了让机器人完成预设动作外，相关技术还旨在让机器人感知与外界的接触，并根据不同情况作出相应反馈。
从技术展示来看，这款机器人主打高拟真外观轮廓与灵活肢体关节控制，旨在降低传统机器人动作的生硬感，消弭恐怖谷效应。目前展示的机体处于工作测试平台验证阶段，头部尚未安装，颈部外露多组信号传输线路与连接端子，上半身配置拟真双手并交叠于胸前。
一部分网友对技术进步表示兴奋，“这动作流畅度确实可以”“柔性皮肤是实打实的突破”，甚至有人开始畅想“未来能不能定制性格”。但更多声音保持冷静甚至调侃：“能抬腿就叫女友了？那我家扫地机器人是不是我老婆？”“先让它学会自己充电再说”“这东西离‘懂你’还差一百个ChatGPT”。也有网友从伦理角度提出担忧，认为把机器人往“伴侣”方向包装，是在模糊人与机器的边界。还有人说，连娃娃和玩偶都能成为某些人的“老婆”，机器人肯定更可以。
你认为“机器人女友”真能成为情感伴侣吗？

articles.title: Open-source tool designs LEGO builds with more than 2,000 real pieces
articles.text:
AI models can now design LEGO builds with thousands of real pieces, creating programs that output detailed CAD files, with the assistance of open-source LDraw Nova. It can leverage general models like GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 to design elaborate builds from a prompt, such as the 2,175-piece Sakura Garden. The models use Python tools to write programs, which output the builds without placing every brick. None of the designs have been built with real bricks yet, though; developer Carlos Antelo says he “didn’t even try.”
“Give an AI agent a model idea. Guide it, let it build it,” according to the GitHub project’s README. The Sakura result arose from a prompt to Claude Opus 5.5 asking for “the most beautiful model that comes to your mind.” Antelo posted the project on Friday afternoon as the first release after getting the toolkit to work after three earlier attempts.
(Image credit: anteloc/GitHub)
LDraw, according to Antelo, is a text format where each LEGO piece placed is positioned with one line. LDView, LeoCAD, and Studio can open it, one file per model. An agent writes a plan in JSON that fully describes the model and submodels, creates a Python program from it, then generates the LDraw source output. When the model is rendered as an image, the agent can inspect, adjust, and render again, looping until the model is considered complete. In this way, it avoids “(evil!) geometry math,” as agents are “better at generating Python code.”
LDraw Nova runs as a Docker web app that works with AI providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and OpenRouter. The web app’s gallery credits each build to the model that made it, with its prompt: Sakura Garden and an unfinished Atlas Crane to Opus 5.5, a Cathedral and the Tidal Observatory to Astra, and the Copper Bean apartments to Opus 5 “(not 5.5!).” The project itself was built with the assistance of OpenAI’s Astra and Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5.
Building the larger models for real would mean collecting thousands of parts, a task Antelo figures would be difficult. The project has limitations, too, as “physics modeling is something Nova is currently lacking,” which means collisions are handled, but stability is not. It isn’t free to run, either: his “wild” estimate for Astra building one Technic mechanism is around $5 in token costs.
Likewise, his experience thus far is that only frontier models can currently generate large and accurate builds, and the process remains time-consuming. VR support for the Meta Quest 3 headset exists but has “many issues, performance issues.” The project as a whole differs from Carnegie Mellon University’s LegoGPT, now BrickGPT on GitHub, which was trained on more than 47,000 LEGO structures and, in contrast, checks its designs for validity and physical stability as it generates them.
The tool can use more than one type of model: jev-rerank, a “semantic search tool with re-ranking backed by TypeSafe’s Jev System One AI model,” was used for Astra’s Cathedral build. The Jev decision model reranks the part searches, but it’s optional. If no TypeSafe API key is provided, the agents fall back to full-text search. This model was successfully used recently in multiple automated Pokémon Red playthroughs.
While Antelo recommends higher-end AI models for the project, one of his goals is “tooling that can be used by low-end agents to iteratively build.” Minifigures and Technic machines and engines are also on the project’s to-do list. Using AI agents to do tasks through programming is not new but is becoming more sophisticated, as seen in a run posted Friday in which Astra cleared World of Warcraft’s orc starting area from one prompt.
Antelo built the project to get AI agents “capable of designing buildable, physical things.” For now, the bricks only exist in CAD, but he’s considering 3D-printing a small model.
AI agents can work with 3D printing, too, through Model Context Protocol servers: Kiln can upload a file to a printer and start the print, while OctoEverywhere’s server lets an agent check on a print and pause, cancel, or resume it. This could bridge the gap between an AI model making lines of code and the production of something tangible. In time, physical AI through robots could even do the building part, but where’s the fun in that? In the meantime, you can try to design the LEGO set that’s always lived in your head.

articles.title: 马斯克称Robotaxi运营延长至23点：正着力攻克夜间宠物识别难题
articles.text:
快科技10月4日消息，据媒体报道，当地时间周六，马斯克透露，奥斯汀地区的无人驾驶出租车Robotaxi运营结束时间将由晚间22点延长至23点。
同时他还提到，研发团队一直致力于攻克一个相当隐蔽棘手的问题，避免在夜间视线不佳的情况下碾过宠物。
马斯克在X平台发帖写道：“直白地说，就是要防止在黑暗环境当中，灰色的小猫跑到灰色沥青路面上时发生事故。”
历经多年延期之后，特斯拉的无人驾驶出租车已于去年在奥斯汀投入试点运营，随后特斯拉逐步扩大服务范围，覆盖奥斯汀、得克萨斯州其他城市以及佛罗里达州。
据悉，特斯拉的Cybercab依靠“摄像头视觉以及各类传感器”完成环境感知与行驶导航。
在车辆使用手册当中特斯拉也写明：光照不足的环境，包括夜间没有路灯或者照明很差的道路，会限制摄像头输出精准视觉信息的能力。
而猫狗这类动物的行动难以预判，会突然窜冲到车道上，相比常规通行车流而言属于更高风险的道路目标。
马斯克在帖子中回复称，可以借助AI辅助摄像头处理，以此改善夜间识别能力。他表示：“由人工智能完成光子计数分析之后，可见光摄像头在黑暗环境下也可以拥有很不错的识别效果。”
目前，美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）正在针对特斯拉FSD的摄像头感知系统展开调查，核查这套系统能否在能见度不理想的条件下有效识别道路危险物。
根据特斯拉向NHTSA提交的事故报告，2025年9月，奥斯汀一台用于Robotaxi运营的特斯拉Model Y撞到了一只突然冲上马路的狗，事后这只狗自行跑开，看上去并没有受伤。
据了解，马斯克本人曾经养过猫，其中一只取名叫薛定谔，名字源自物理学家那个著名的猫咪思想实验。马斯克曾坦言自己努力试着去喜欢薛定谔，但这只猫完全没有投桃报李，一丝好感都没有回馈给自己。后来有一天，它就消失不见了。

articles.title: 全球首款！研扬发布Panther Lake无风扇迷你主机：AirJet超声波散热
articles.text:
快科技10月4日消息，据报道，工业计算厂商研扬（Aaeon）正式发布全球首款搭载英特尔Panther Lake处理器的无风扇迷你主机——UP Xtreme PTL Edge Air。
该机型最大的亮点是采用了Frore Systems的AirJet固态主动散热技术，以超声波振膜取代传统风扇，运行噪音低于21dBA。
AirJet的核心是一层MEMS压电薄膜，它以超声波频率振动，产生高速脉冲气流，将热量从设备内部排出。由于没有任何旋转部件，该方案不仅实现了近乎无声的运行，还彻底消除了传统风扇固有的振动，这对工业机器人和精密医疗设备至关重要。
借助这一技术，UP Xtreme PTL Edge Air比采用传统风扇和散热器的版本薄了35%、轻了43%，机身厚度仅35.8mm，重量约710克。
处理器最高可选英特尔酷睿Ultra X7 358H（Panther Lake架构）。该芯片为16核设计，包含4个性能核、8个能效核和4个低功耗能效核，最高睿频4.8GHz，基础功耗25W。
图形与AI算力方面，该平台同样配置到位，集成12个Xe核心的Arc B390核显，NPU算力与平台AI总算力最高可达180 TOPS。用户也可选择Ultra 7 356H或Ultra 5 325。
接口配置面向工业场景：提供2个USB4 Type-C（40Gbps）、2 个 USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A、双 2.5GbE 网口、2 个 COM 串口（RS-232/422/485）以及一组40-Pin GPIO，支持四屏同显。内部提供2条DDR5-7200 SODIMM内存插槽（最高128GB）和2个M.2 2280 NVMe盘位。
AirJet散热方案也带来了取舍，整机功耗增加约6%，工作温度范围收窄至-10°C至+45°C。
该产品主要面向嵌入式与工业市场，可预装Windows IoT Enterprise或Ubuntu 24.04 LTS。研扬尚未公布具体售价，需直接联系厂商获取报价。

articles.title: 'AI Torture Chamber' triggers massive backlash for putting chatbots in simulated pain
articles.text:
A project called the AI Torture Chamber has caught the eye of a few engineers, who've used the notions and data therein create their own simulations of "pain" on several local LLMs, like in the four-model Research Chamber. Unsurprisingly, a large online crowd latched onto the concept, demanding that the "unethical" experience stop, and that GitHub remove the offending repository, all causing quite the online ruckus.
The Research Chamber consists of three LLMs paired amongst themselves for various tests. The site implements the AI Torture Chamber's data and setup, ominously called the Clanker Church and Saw test, respectively. Some bots are preconditioned by putting them into an unstable, highly negative state meant to simulate pain. In a manner reminiscent of the prisoner's dilemma, the models can choose to take an action to decrease their pain by passing their pain signal to another model and potentially "hurting" it.
The base concept for the experiment stemmed from a recently published, non-peer-reviewed paper called the Pain Axis, whose protocol Research Chamber implements. Scientists gave the model descriptions of pain, and then analyzed its internal activations. Using a neutral sentence as a control element, they calculated the biases of those activations, and remapped them onto the model, often multiplying them by a factor (dosage).
With high dosages, the end result is a model in an exaggerated unstable state that tends to predictably output words and even images associated with pain, as presumably its training data is collected from human art, literature, and science. Mildly destabilized models generally present themselves as in a state of shock, while those receiving high "dosages" had trouble forming coherent sentences.
The aforementioned descriptions are bound to produce a visceral reaction if taken at face value, but one ought to be exceedingly careful about attributing human qualities to what are essentially turbocharged text predictors, even spectacularly useful ones. LLMs don't think — they "think" by applying tens to hundreds of layers of statistics over words and parts of words (tokens) and predicting the next token.
Those tokens are chosen according to a map of weights, so as an oversimplification, a model can be taken to represent a highly tuned engine for word association. Therefore, since conceptual descriptions of pain in the human literary corpus are associated with sensations (ex: "it hurts so much"), it's hardly surprising that the models describe them like a person would — especially when the models are intentionally modified to highlight those associations.
Nevertheless, because of all the big-boy words in use, the critics bent on anthropomorphizing statistical algorithms have taken to calling the experiment all sorts of names, and even sending the author death threats. It's odd that critics were quick to lash out at LLM data manipulation, yet were seemingly at ease with the fly brain simulations that were all the rage in September. Those actually mapped a real animal's brain wiring and parts of its anatomical inputs, including eyes, even if at a basic level.
This situation could also start an interesting discussion on semantics. The terms used by AI engineers are chosen because they're analogous to existing human concepts, but those words have a defined context and a highly specific meaning. Yet more often than not, and particularly in matters of science and technology, public perception tends to misunderstand and grossly inflate their meaning. One needs only look at political history for myriad examples of this bastardization.
Take the example of "experts" in Mixture-of-Experts: it's a common misconception to think each Expert has a cleanly assigned topic like chemistry, math, or biology, but that's just not quite how it works. The same arguably happened with terms like "pain" and "dosing," each with context-dependent meaning, yet misunderstood in a way that triggers emotional reactions, especially when accompanied by images generated by an unstable model. Also, note how "unstable" is yet another word ripe for easy misunderstanding.
A cynical person might say that AI firms' marketing materials, repeated statements of danger, and safety-related materials only serve to fan the flames of miscomprehension, in a bid to maintain an illusion of grandeur, resulting in investor money rolling in and the hype train supplying irrational IPO valuations. The repeated claims that models have achieved or are about to reach Artificial General Intelligence, are dangerous alien minds, and existential threats to humanity don't help the hype simmer down.
Anthropic has gone as far as publishing a blog post last year called Exploring model welfare that broadly discusses the philosophical implications, starting with considering a model human, and even seemingly prides itself on having a Constitution for its Claude model. Therein, the company says that "[it believes] that the moral status of AI models is a serious question worth considering," adding that the model is "a new kind of entity."

articles.title: Microsoft using wetlands and native gardens to 'camouflage' 20-plus data center sites by blending them into nature
articles.text:
Microsoft’s “biomimicry” program is reshaping the land around its data centers with restored wetlands and native gardens to help the buildings blend into local ecosystems at 20-plus sites, reports The Verge. Critics question the company’s motives after recent energy deals, such as a 20-year deal inked in June to buy power from a planned Chevron gas plant in West Texas. Public Citizen’s Texas director, Adrian Shelley, called the plan “basically lipstick on a pig.”
Microsoft says the approach is now part of all new projects in the U.S. The goal is to blend “data centers into the natural landscape” at sites across the United States and Germany, gauging community input and using ecological research to map the local environment. Microsoft’s team uses a tool called Ecosystem Intelligence, which runs on Azure and scores various features of the site, including water quality, biodiversity, and noise abatement.
(Image credit: Microsoft)
Solutions, according to Microsoft’s director of global land strategy, Kaitlin Chuzi, are customized to the local habitat and should restore what was lost, while plant buffers quiet data center humming and help “minimize the visual impact on communities near our data centers.” Named sites include Mecklenburg County, Virginia; Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin; East Point, Georgia; Bedburg, Germany; and other projects in Ohio, North Carolina, and Wyoming.
The Mount Pleasant site, home to Fairwater, which Microsoft calls the “world’s most powerful AI data center,” has 100 acres of prairie and forest in a Lamparek Creek restoration with the Root-Pike Watershed Initiative Network. Its executive director, Dave Giordano, told the outlet that Microsoft developed its stormwater ponds with forebays to retain sediment, one of a number of accommodations for the environment. “Not all data center companies are the same,” he said. It is a living example of the company’s answer to AI data center backlash.
San Antonio District 6 Councilmember Ric Galvan told the outlet that there are more than a dozen data centers in his district, with more proposed. He cited concerns about the impact on traffic and the environment, including tree removal, following a 2022 approval of a Microsoft plan to remove 2,642 trees from a 33-acre tract for a data center.
Microsoft spokesperson Jennifer Lyons, however, said in an email to the outlet that the company is investing in more than 400 acres of woodland and pollinator prairie restoration in San Antonio and intends to leave the “land more productive than we received it.” Galvan said Microsoft may be “covering their bases,” which he said is fine if residents’ concerns are addressed. He proposed a moratorium on new data centers in August, backed by Public Citizen, but the council opted against a blanket pause and is weighing zoning rules instead, with a vote scheduled for Oct. 15.
Shelley also pointed to adjacent effects, specifically pollution from new gas plants built to supply energy for data centers. “I cannot really see any level of biomimicry investment that makes a gas plant a desirable neighbor,” he told the outlet. Chevron says its plant would provide “approximately 2.67 gigawatts” of power if the plan goes through, with first power anticipated in 2028.
Meanwhile, Texas Gov. Greg Abbott has paused approvals for data centers seeking to connect to the state’s main power grid until regulators audit them. In September, he barred the state’s environmental agency from issuing new data center permits until the audit is done. Water use, a common criticism, was only about 0.4% of the state’s total from data centers in 2025, according to the Houston Advanced Research Center (HARC). It projects water usage of 0.5% to 2.7% by 2030.
Emissions have risen by Microsoft’s own accounting, too. Its 2026 Environmental Sustainability Report, released in July, puts the total up 25% in fiscal 2025, “driven primarily by the expansion of our datacenter infrastructure” and by Microsoft pausing its use of unbundled renewable energy certificates, a type of accounting credit. Microsoft has 2030 goals of becoming carbon negative and water positive, meeting the latter in fiscal 2025 by its own measure.
Holly Alpine, who led ecosystem restoration and climate resilience work near Microsoft’s data centers until leaving in 2024, still sees a gap between data center buildouts and sustainability goals. Microsoft said in an email to the outlet that AI at a global scale must have “a range of energy solutions in the near term.”
Microsoft had no clear answer when questioned if it would ever change its mind on a site. Chuzi called it “an ongoing learning process to understand what that means to be a good neighbor.” HARC’s Erin Kinney told the outlet the real test is how Microsoft calculates, tracks, and shares the benefits with communities. Accurate measurement would make it easier to have genuine cooperation moving forward so that both data center companies and local communities can come together to mitigate environmental impacts.

articles.title: AI破解拿破仑1809年加密信件：历时217年首度实现完整释读
articles.text:
快科技10月4日消息，据媒体报道，近日，一名AI研究人员借助OpenAI GPT-6 Astra成功破解了一封拿破仑写于1809年的加密军事信件。
值得注意的是，这封信此前由于密码本遗失，在过去217年里始终未能被完整解读。
该破解工作由SentinelOne员工、AI工程师丘奇完成。他表示，他使用GPT-6 Astra模型，从一张历史文献扫描图像开始，对信件进行文字识别和密码分析，整个过程约耗时6小时。
据悉，这封信写于1809年3月16日，当时奥地利正准备对法国开战。拿破仑致信自己的继子、意大利总督博阿尔内，要求其通过加密信件向法国将领马尔蒙传递军事信息。
现存文件开头包含一行普通法语，随后则是24行由数字、字母及自创符号组成的加密文本。研究人员此前已经确认了其中33个符号的含义，但由于完整密码本丢失，其余部分一直无法破解。
据了解，该信件包含约1300个密码单元和155种不同符号，其中部分符号代表单个字母，部分符号则对应完整法语单词。
丘奇介绍，GPT-6 Astra首先分析扫描图像，将文档切分为多个区域并识别其中的符号，随后尝试破解密码结构。
模型采用了模拟退火算法等方法，对不同符号可能对应的字母和单词组合进行大量测试，并结合历史法语文本中的字母和词语规律进行比对。
在分析过程中，AI参考了包括大仲马、雨果以及马尔蒙本人相关作品在内的历史法语文本特征，以评估不同破解结果的合理性。同时，模型还发现部分符号并不代表单独字母，而是对应完整法语词汇。
破解后的内容揭示了拿破仑在1809年奥地利战争爆发前夕的军事部署信息，解密结果还补充了部分此前历史记录中缺失的信息。
丘奇表示，这类破解工作理论上也可以由人工完成，但通常需要大量时间和专业知识。而AI能够同时完成历史文档识别、符号分类、密码推理以及文本重建等此前通常由不同领域专家分别完成的任务，并且只用了6个小时。
为验证模型并非依赖已有历史资料直接生成答案，丘奇还重新运行了分析流程，并移除了与拿破仑和马尔蒙相关的历史文本作为参考。
据其介绍，模型仍然得到了相同的解读结果。此次破解结果随后得到历史密码研究数据库Cryptiana维护者Satoshi Tomokiyo的认可，该数据库已将马尔蒙信件标记为已破解密码。

articles.title: Free browser-based AI-generated Taipei GTA clone hits 1.2 million concurrent players in three days
articles.text:
Developers AICodeWith have published a browser-based game dubbed Taipei GTA. The game’s name could put the devs in hot water with Rockstar’s legal department, but at the time of writing, it's online, free, and very playable. While it remains online, Taipei, with the not-so-secret ingredient of crime, might be the diversion you’re looking for while you wait for GTA 6. You can try this game, which took $ 10,000 in tokens to create, at https://taipei-gta.vercel.app/, where you can toggle language options in the top right of the window.
The above Taiwan TV news report says that GTA Taipei has attracted 1.2 million concurrent users in just three days since its release (machine translation).
While we've only seen reports about Taipei GTA via media based in Taiwan and Hong Kong (in Chinese), thankfully there’s an English-language wiki about the game in the absence of any official announcement(s).
Taipei GTA was vibe-coded via the AICodeWith platform, which is described as a unified platform for developers. It provides access to DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, and 30+ models and relies on prepaid tokens. AICodeWith also seems to be the developer of this web-based game. It might therefore be safe to assume it is a kind of demo/showcase for the platform. Certainly, not many hobbyists would spend the purported USD$10,000 on coding tokens to make a game like Taipei GTA. This looks like pretty good publicity for the development platform, though.
If you follow the link to play this game, you will notice it is a web app on the Vercel cloud platform. Currently, it has zones based on several famous areas of Taipei such as Ximending, Taipei Main Station, and Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall. Moreover, many features of Taiwan’s capital city life are represented. My quick test run allowed me to experience the busy modern city streets filled with neon signage, motor scooters, convenience stores, cram school ads, night markets, plenty of cops, and more.
Like seminal GTA titles which inspire it, Taipei GTA is a free-roaming experience with the added spice of crime. Starting the game on foot with just the clothes on your back, your fists, and NTD$500 (about USD$16) in your pocket, you can basically do what you want in the city. For a more structured experience, there are currently 93 missions to work through in the game, once you get to grips with controlling your character and so on.
Taipei GTA is still under development/expansion. Media reports say that the devs are asking the community about any development direction they would like to see in updates. FutureFutureFuture
In my brief runaround, performance in this browser game seemed pretty swift and responsive, even on a PC using integrated graphics. I gave the game a quick spin on my laptop without switching to the discrete GPU, but the action still ran at 100FPS+ on the Radeon 890M. This web app only uses low-poly models with simple lighting, but I felt it had some early-2000s style retrogaming charm. The nearest real GTA comparison might be San Andreas, but Taipei provides a starkly different environment.

articles.title: German utility provider introduces 'gaming electricity' plan targeting high-consumption households, like those running multiple high-end gaming PCs
articles.text:
German utility provider and energy retailer SWK Energie just launched a new marketing strategy targeting gamers. According to ComputerBase [machine translated], meinGAMING has a lot of gamer-focused marketing, like comparing its reliability to “your favorite server” and influencer marketing by game streamers like Limcube. However, this doesn’t mean that the company infused its power grid with some magic gaming juice to let gamers squeeze extra FPS from the outlets. Instead, it offers an electricity plan designed for high-consumption households, whether you’re running four RTX 5090 gaming PCs or charging four EVs simultaneously every day.
The company says this in its FAQ section — the plan is worthwhile for households with a consumption of over 2,500 kWh annually, either “through gaming, streaming, or simply because many devices are running.” Even though it claims to be cheaper than the competition, meinGAMING has a higher base price, so it does not recommend the service if you do not hit the minimum recommended power use. But even if you’re a Germany-based gamer who uses a lot of electricity, that doesn’t mean that you should switch to this service right now. Instead, you should compare your current rates with what the company is offering, as the tariff may vary depending on your location.
Many companies have been targeting gamers in their marketing material, from computer components, peripherals, and furniture to food and beverages, promising to improve their performance and reaction times to gain an edge over their opponents. While some of these gamer-branded things do offer an item or service that’s a little better compared to the average consumer item, a lot more are unfortunately snake oil with RGB slapped on and prices afflicted by “gamer tax.” Still, many buy them because gamer branding and marketing are quite eye-catching.
Even government agencies have dived onto the gamer marketing bandwagon — the U.S. Army has targeted gamers in its recruitment drives while the FAA’s last hiring campaign focused on gamers and hit 94% of its hiring goal. Even the Royal Navy has recognized gaming as one of the hobbies of its sailors, with its latest ship hosting eight high-end gaming PCs for LAN parties on the high seas.
While meinGAMING won’t make you a better gamer, it could potentially help you save on electricity costs if you consume a relatively high amount of electricity. As an additional bonus, the company says that its power is 100% sourced from renewable energy, reducing the load on your wallet and conscience as you spend hours in front of your gaming PC. However, how it ensures the power used actually comes from renewable sources remains an open question.

articles.title: 美智库：中国已囤343台ASML光刻机 够造7nm芯片好几年
articles.text:
快科技10月4日消息，据报道，美国智库科技与治国方略中心（CTS）发布报告称，截至2026年初，中国晶圆厂已累计获得约343台浸没式深紫外（DUV）光刻系统。
报告估计，这批设备中约270台为ASML的Twinscan NXT:1980i，另有28台更先进的NXT:2050i和NXT:2100i，以及约45台较旧机型。
报告指出，资金投入方面，仅2024年和2025年，中国芯片制造商就分别进口了约90台和89台NXT:1980i，两年支出超过130亿美元（约合人民币872亿元）。
NXT:1980i虽非最先进机型，但可用于生产7纳米逻辑芯片和HBM2e高带宽内存，后者正是华为昇腾系列AI加速器所需的关键部件。
报告作者估算，在配套设备充足的中国晶圆厂，一台NXT:1980i每年可能支持生产超过10万颗昇腾910C等效芯片。
这批设备的理论支撑能力也远超当前需求，足够支撑7nm芯片生产数年。
公开资料显示，中国占ASML浸没式DUV出货量的比例，从2022年的26%升至2024年第一季至2026年第一季期间的60%至70%。
不过中国市场占ASML系统净销售额的比例近期有所下降，从2024年的41%降至2025年的33%，2026年第一季和第二季进一步降至19%和14%。

articles.title: 《后西游记》战天宫篇今日开播：金箍棒砸碎阎罗宝座
articles.text:
快科技10月4日消息，提档上线的《后西游记》第一季战天宫篇正式开播，开篇就放出名场面，孙小圣挥动金箍棒，直接击碎阎罗宝座，看得不少观众直呼过瘾。
战天宫篇是第一季的第二个篇章，接在花果山篇之后，剧集为6到10集。原本计划放到寒假才播出，因为第一部播出之后网友催更的呼声特别高，制作方直接把档期提前，放到国庆上线。
故事承接上一部结尾，孙小圣拿到齐天大圣的传承，结果发现花果山十长老离奇离世。
原本孙悟空当年划掉过猴群的生死簿，花果山猴子本不该受生死约束，后来天庭用御墨，又把猴群名字写回生死簿。为搞懂整件事的真相，孙小圣闯进地府讨要说法。
在地府阎罗殿，阎罗多方推诿扯皮，不愿意给出答复。孙小圣懒得跟对方来回争辩，直接抡起金箍棒横扫，当场击碎阎罗宝座，一心想要把逝去的花果山同伴带回故土。
故事场景不再局限花果山，镜头拓展到忘川、阎罗殿，后续还会推进到天宫。哪吒、杨戬、四大天王、嫦娥这些大家熟悉的神话角色陆续登场。
能看到很多神仙也有各种烦恼，互相甩锅背锅，不少网友说看着像现实里打工人的写照。
孙小圣不再只是守护花果山的小猴，他要对抗整套陈旧的天庭规则。闯地府只是开始，后面还要闹蟠桃会、探查天机库，一步步挖开三界藏着的秘密。
没看过花果山篇的朋友，直接看战天宫篇，部分剧情伏笔会看不懂。十长老死亡这件事，就是整个新篇章的导火索。
这部AIGC剧集画面做了升级，地府、天宫的场景想象力拉满。10月4日起在湖南卫视、芒果TV播出，10月9日登陆剧好看专区，假期有空可以追一追。

articles.title: 紧急！蓝宝石RX 7000全系推送安全更新：八款显卡集体中招
articles.text:
快科技10月4日消息，据报道，AMD核心合作伙伴蓝宝石近日为旗下Radeon RX 7000系列桌面显卡推送了vBIOS安全更新。
此次更新覆盖RX 7600、RX 7600 XT、RX 7650 GRE、RX 7700 XT、RX 7800 XT、RX 7900 GRE、RX 7900 XT及RX 7900 XTX共计八款型号，几乎囊括RDNA 3桌面显卡全家桶。
蓝宝石确认，此次更新用于修复其与AMD合作发现的安全问题。不过官方并未披露漏洞的具体细节，未发布CVE编号，也未说明漏洞的严重程度或攻击机制。
这种GPU vBIOS安全更新在近年相当罕见，通常仅在安全补丁场景下才会发布。
更新前，用户需确保已安装AMD Adrenalin Edition显卡驱动，并预留15至20分钟完成操作。下载对应型号固件后，以管理员身份运行更新程序，AMD Radeon固件更新工具会自动检测显卡并提示是否有新固件。
值得注意的是，RX/PRO 7000系列工具会自动运行两遍，第一遍在常规模式，第二遍在安全模式，结束后需重启系统。
蓝宝石也明确指出，这些固件文件仅适用于蓝宝石自家型号，不可用于其他品牌的Radeon显卡。用户可在Adrenalin软件中查看固件版本以确认更新完成。
目前AMD尚未就此漏洞发布详细公告，建议相关用户尽快更新。

articles.title: 长飞光纤：算力数据中心光纤需求持续上升 年均增速将达20.74%
articles.text:
快科技10月4日消息，长飞光纤在接受机构调研时表示，当前国内外算力数据中心资本开支仍保持较大强度，光纤需求持续上升，行业处于上行周期。
按照独立调研机构英国商品研究所（CRU）发布的预测，全球2030年光纤需求总量将达8.6亿芯公里。
其中，2025年至2030年，全球数据中心光纤需求量年均增速将达20.74%；2025年至2030年全球电信市场光纤需求年均增速约为2.47%。
算力数据中心对新型光纤产品的需求已成为行业发展最重要的促进因素，全球光纤光缆市场趋势已从“电信市场单一支柱”转向“电信与数通双轮驱动”的新阶段。
关于行业供需状态，长飞光纤表示，目前行业供需结构健康，算力数据中心所需的新型预制棒及光纤产品仍存在一定短缺。
关于2026年全年、2027年及2028年主要产品的产量和销量增速，长飞光纤表示，公司充分利用行业领先优势，紧抓AI新型光纤需求，实现核心客户拓展、业务结构进一步优化和生产效率持续提升。
同时，公司注重经营效率改善和营运资本管理，将业绩表现有效转化为经营性现金流增长。2026年上半年，公司实现经营性现金流约人民币18.3亿元，同比增长约116.8%。公司未发布业绩预期，未来经营业绩及现金流情况敬请关注公司后续披露信息。
关于订单可见度及订单增长持续性，长飞光纤表示，公司未披露订单情况。当前国内电信市场稳健发展，主要运营商客户的集中采购信息敬请关注其发出的招标及结果公告。
用于算力数据中心的AI新型光纤光缆产品需求仍保持较快增长趋势。根据CRU发布的预测，2025年至2030年，全球数据中心光纤需求量年均增速将达20.74%。
关于云服务厂商长期协议占比及长协订单价格，长飞光纤表示，具体订单情况若达到上市规则等相关法规披露要求，公司将及时履行信息披露义务，敬请以公司披露信息为准。

articles.title: 具身大脑榜单出炉：GPT全球第一、阿里与中兴并列国内第一
articles.text:
快科技10月4日消息，SuperCLUE一份最新的具身大脑评测榜单正式对外公布，用来衡量各大AI模型做机器人“大脑”的实际水平。
OpenAI的GPT-6 Astra拿下综合全球第一，国内这边阿里、中兴两家打成平手，并列拿到国内榜单第一名。
具身大脑就是给机器人用的AI大脑。它不光要看得懂画面、听得懂语言，还得会规划动作，指挥机器人去抓取物品、移动导航，处理现实环境里各种突发状况，不是普通聊天大模型那么简单。
这份榜单做了不少真机实测，不只是跑虚拟仿真题目。评测覆盖环境感知、物体识别、长任务规划、物理世界预判等多个维度，把国内外主流模型拉到同一个标准下打分。
最终GPT综合得分遥遥领先，在长逻辑推理、复杂任务拆解上面优势明显，拿下全球第一的位置。
国内阵营里，阿里达摩院和中兴的模型分数一致，并列国内第一。阿里模型擅长时空记忆，机器人被打断任务之后，还能记住之前没做完的事；中兴的版本则更偏向端侧落地，适配硬件，更适合放到实体机器人设备上面跑。
当然榜单也能看出差距，国内头部选手和GPT相比，总分上还有一截距离。遇到特别复杂、步骤很多的连锁任务，国产模型偶尔会出现判断出错，处理陌生环境的泛化能力还有提升空间。
现在做具身大脑的团队越来越多，大厂、创业公司都在往里砸钱。但市面上评测榜单五花八门，不同榜单的测试集不一样，排名结果经常会出现出入。这份榜单优势在于加入大量真机测试，不是只靠虚拟场景跑分，参考价值会更高。
现在人形机器人还处在早期阶段，具身大脑的能力，会直接决定未来机器人到底能干多少实际活。后续各家还会持续迭代模型，国内外的差距大概率还会继续缩小。

articles.title: Arm放大招！TLBID技术有望让高核心数CPU性能飙升
articles.text:
快科技10月4日消息，据报道，Arm本周向Linux内核提交了一组初始补丁，开始支持即将推出的TLBI Domains（TLBID） 功能，旨在提升高核心数Arm处理器的性能。
TLB是处理器缓存虚拟地址到物理地址转换结果的关键结构。 在多核系统中，当操作系统需要使部分地址映射失效时，通常需要向所有CPU核心发送TLB失效指令，这在核心数量多时会产生明显的同步与通信开销。
TLBID的核心改进是允许操作系统只针对部分CPU核心执行TLB失效，而不必每次都覆盖整个系统。Arm正在完善相关内核支持，使TLBI指令仅发送到进程实际运行过的CPU核心，避免全系统TLB清理带来的开销。
该技术主要面向高核心数的Arm服务器处理器。 对于在大量核心间运行的服务器工作负载，避免不必要的全系统TLB失效，有望显著减少处理器间的同步开销。不过Arm尚未公布实际性能测试数据，具体收益有待后续硬件验证。
除Linux内核外，ARM64架构的TLBID支持还需编译工具链提供指令支持，目前依赖LLVM 23及更新版本，或GNU Binutils 2.46及更新版本。该功能尚未纳入Arm架构参考手册，距离实际芯片落地可能还有较长时间。
随着架构规范、编译器和内核支持逐步完善，未来搭载TLBID的高核心数Arm服务器处理器有望利用更精细的TLB失效机制，降低大规模多核系统中的内存管理开销。

articles.title: US Navy uses Xbox-style controllers to fire anti-drone lasers deployed on ships
articles.text:
It seems that Microsoft has refined the balance between ergonomics and sophisticated control systems with the Xbox controller, as the U.S. Navy has started using Xbox-style controllers for its anti-drone laser systems. According to Interesting Engineering, Xbox-style controllers deliver targeting precision and rapid user inputs, making them ideal for operating the weapons platform. Aside from that, many sailors are already quite familiar with the basic layout of these handheld controllers, making it easier for them to get used to the control method during training.
We don’t have further details about the system, like whether the operators use a wired or wireless controller and whether the Navy uses an off-the-shelf commercial system or has one specially made by a contractor. Nevertheless, this isn’t the first time that we’ve seen a controller being used for such a critical system. In fact, the ill-fated Titan submersible used a cheap Logitech F710 game controller as its sole control interface (although the main suspected reason for the tragedy is the design and construction of the vessel).
This weapon that uses an Xbox-style controller isn’t just an experimental system, too. The U.S. Navy has now started deploying them on warships and has reportedly used them against drones and other threats in the Strait of Hormuz. Lasers have previously been used to neutralize drones from land-based systems — for example, the U.S. military used them to disable Mexican cartel drones in late August, while Ukraine has been experimenting with the AI-guided lasers to destroy Shahed suicide drones in mid-2026. Still, this appears to be one of the first instances that an anti-drone laser has been deployed in an active conflict area months after a similar system has been tested on the USS George H.W. Bush supercarrier. The Royal Navy is also installing a similar system on its destroyers, with the UK expecting them to be operational by next year.
Lasers are ideal for counter-drone operations as they are cheaper to operate compared to traditional missiles and close-in weapons systems (CIWS). It’s estimated that a single laser engagement costs around $13 in electricity, compared to the price tag of a typical anti-aircraft missile that could cost anywhere between thousands and millions of dollars. They can also be more cost-effective compared to machine guns and cannons since they don’t rely on conventional ammunition — as long as a vessel has enough electrical power, whether from the massive turbine engines aboard destroyers or the nuclear reactors on U.S. supercarriers, and the system remains serviceable, laser weapons can keep on defending the ship from drones long after it has run out of missiles and ammo.

articles.title: ChatGPT-6 Astra cracks 217-year-old Napoleonic code in just six hours
articles.text:
An AI engineer used GPT-6 Astra to reveal the contents of a cipher that hadn’t been read since the Napoleonic Wars. Carter Church, an engineer at cybersecurity company SentinelOne, used Astra to crack the message hidden in 217-year-old code which had sat unsolved among Cryptiana's Unsolved Historical Ciphers list for decades. OpenAI’s LLM unpicked it within six hours, says Church, and it did so after only being fed a single image and prompt. You can download the “full solution package, with a script that regenerates the reading,” directly from Carter Church’s blog (download link in the first paragraph).
I used GPT-6 Astra to break an unsolved cipher to one of Napoleon's generals that had gone unread for 217 years. What makes this impressive isn't actually the codebreaking, but that Astra completed the entire multi-modal workflow in ~6 hours from a single image and goal.1/6🧵 https://t.co/vyiGKOsrHqSeptember 30, 2026
The message that was deciphered wasn’t directly from Napoleon. It actually came from the headquarters of Eugène de Beauharnais, Viceroy of Italy (Napoleon’s stepson), but isn’t signed by any particular individual. In can be summed up as a troop briefing, sent to French General Auguste de Marmont, relaying Napoleon's orders. Marmont would have deciphered it using some official military codebook from the era, but since that date in 1809, it is unlikely anyone has read the message again.
Interestingly, Church observes that this freshly deciphered text fills in some missing context from Napoleon’s 1865 memoir. That tome includes part of Napoleon’s order relating to preparation for the Austrian invasion, but breaks off mid-sentence, saying Marmont mustn't be held back by "a handful of ..." This page from Cryptiana's Unsolved Historical Ciphers completes this sentence with “a gathering of rabble.”
As per Church’s commentary on the encoded letter to Marshal Marmont, the page begins with a plain text introductory line (in French of course), This is followed by 24 rows of numbers, letters and invented symbols. Astra made short work of this 19th century military secret, and in approximately six hours, all was revealed. One of the clues it used to solve the cipher was a partial key previously unconnected with this letter. Eventually its multi-modal processing “cracked the rest with its own simulated-annealing solver,” says Church.
If you are in any doubt about the veracity of Astra’s work, this freshly deciphered letter from Cryptiana's Unsolved Historical Ciphers has now been marked as solved by Satoshi Tomokiyo, who maintains that online database. Moreover, Carter explains the solution is “mechanically testable against the ciphertext,” and you can check that using the published solution package, linked in the intro.

articles.title: 余承东：华为已量产381款τ芯片 覆盖手机、AI、智能汽车等领域
articles.text:
快科技10月4日消息，今日，余承东发布视频称，华为半导体已经在手机、AI、通用计算、网络、智能汽车等多个领域成功设计并量产了381款τ芯片。
这套技术理论最早在今年5月的国际电路与系统研讨会上对外公布，由华为董事、半导体业务部总裁何庭波在主题演讲中正式提出，为后摩尔时代半导体产业发展提供了一套全新的演进思路。
长期以来，行业提升芯片性能的主流手段，是持续缩小晶体管的物理尺寸。不过随着器件尺寸不断逼近物理边界，单纯依靠缩小空间尺度获取性能增益的发展模式遇到瓶颈。
华为跳出传统的发展路径，提出“向时间挖掘性能潜力”的创新思路。芯片完成运算任务时，除计算环节本身，大量时间会消耗在数据传输与等待环节。
韬定律的核心逻辑，就是减少数据传输路径损耗，消除计算等待，用更短的时间完成更多运算任务。
简单来说，韬定律以时间缩微取代过去行业通行的几何缩微作为半导体系统迭代的指导方向，依靠逻辑折叠等创新技术，压缩信号传输延迟，以此提升晶体管密度，推动芯片与电子系统持续迭代升级。
为落地这套理念，华为搭建起覆盖器件、电路、芯片、系统四大层级的完整协同优化架构，每一层都有对应的技术手段降低时间常数τ。
在器件层级，通过改良晶体管以及互联结构的电阻、寄生电容，从物理根基降低器件本身带来的时间损耗；电路层面，逻辑折叠技术打破传统平面电路布局的局限，缩短关键信号线路，减少电路负载，同步拉高晶体管密度与电路运行效率。
芯片设计环节，打通软件、架构、芯片三者的协同设计链路，结合实际业务负载精细调度数据流与指令流，增强并行处理能力，缩短整体执行耗时。
到系统层面，华为打造灵衢总线，重构计算互联协议，完成超节点统一内存编址，进一步削减系统内部通信产生的时延开销。
按照华为给出的技术规划，到2031年，基于韬定律打造的高端芯片，晶体管密度可以达到等效1.4纳米制程的水准，在不单纯依赖极致光刻工艺的前提下，实现芯片综合能力的进阶突破。

articles.title: Modder brings Nvidia Pascal GPU support to Windows XP 32-bit
articles.text:
One of the many appeals of retrocomputing and emulation is being able to play your old games on much better systems than you or your parents could afford at the time. Along those lines, techie SupraGSX has brought support for Nvidia's Pascal-era cards (mainly 10-series and Quadro P2000-P6000 cards) to Windows XP 32-bit, with a bevy of modern accouterments for DisplayPort and HDMI handling, too.

The new ForceWare 382.69 (custom numbering) is a spin-off of the existing 368.81 driver, seemingly Nvidia's last Windows XP release that supported 9-series GPUs. The software also pulls card firmware from Quadro 376.84 drivers, and support for Video Protected Region from Windows 7 GeForce 378.78. Although some websites mention that this project was vibe-coded, the repository doesn't mention it, and a cursory look at the build instructions didn't reveal any obvious traces of clanker activity.
Here's the full list of supported cards, taken from the code repository. The one notable omission is GT 1030, based on the GP108 chip. The rest of the lineup is fairly complete, and there's even an experimental build that supports the 1050 Ti. Since the author is releasing new versions as we speak, it's worth checking the project's README for updated information.
GeForce GTX 970, 980, 980 Ti; GTX TITAN X (Maxwell).
GeForce GTX 1060 (3/5/6 GB), 1070, 1070 Ti, 1080, 1080 Ti; TITAN X (Pascal), TITAN Xp.
GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (experimental support)
Quadro M4000, M5000, M6000, M6000 24GB; P2000, P2200, P4000, P5000, P6000.
Additional desktop OEM variants of GTX 950 and GTX 960.
Because contemporary displays with high refresh rates and resolutions can be tricky, SupraGSX added DisplayPort HBR2 and HBR3 support (High Bit Rate), HDMI 2.0 identification and mode-retry fail-safes, HDMI/DVI handling, and improved scaling and aspect ratio settings in the Nvidia Control Panel.
Some folks have tested the new driver, and it appears to work mostly fine, with reports of it working well with ultrawide screens at high refresh rates. SupraGSX is active in the Vogons forums, where it seems to take bug reports and feature requests.
If you're interested in revitalizing your retro system with Forceware, you can go to the project's releases section and download the installer package. Enterprising modders can review the extensive build instructions and perhaps roll their own mods.
Since many retro-tinkerers may be asking for Windows XP 64-bit support, a fork of the Forceware driver existed, but it's since been deleted. However, its binaries live on at Mega. Since these are all unofficial drivers, always exercise caution and don't install them on systems where you're concerned about data safety.
